This is an exact causal-image count for a flat quotient, not a sourced wormhole or A.R.G.O. route. The free image sum diverges when the identification is timelike. Adding g < 1 makes a phenomenological series converge only by sending energy out of the tracked mode or into an explicit sink; a quotient field does not acquire that attenuation automatically. The model has no Earth worldline, historical optical source, or quantum-state solution.
